title: Federation Phase 3 — every member federates as themselves
notes: Members now each have their own fediverse identity (@you@your-community) instead of posting from one shared community account. People can follow individual members, topics and replies go out attributed to their real author, your handle shows on your profile, and replies reach the author's followers, the community's followers, and remote thread participants.

changelog.text: Per-member fediverse identities — each member federates as @you@your-community and can be followed individually.
Your fediverse handle is shown on your profile and is discoverable by handle from any fediverse server.
Replies are delivered to the author's followers, the community's followers, and remote thread participants.
